about: Every test key of Accounts-core (ACC-T### core, EML-T### email, TEL-T### telemetry): each test's name starts with its key, listed here in the same commit. A key is never reused; a red test is never weakened, skipped or deleted.

keys.says: every code has plain words and an unknown code is a bug
owner settings: unset refuses and names every missing number; nothing is assumed
only a person changes an account; an assistant or an unnamed actor is refused
the memory store passes the store check that a product runs on its own vault
the record is hash-chained: an entry changed afterwards is found
a checked identity is required, and an email is shown masked
the first sign-in makes an account and a session; the next finds it
the store keeps no provider subject, no session token and only an email account its address
sessions need the owner's length, end on time and close on sign-out
a second sign-in is joined only by the signed-in person, never to two accounts
a sign-in is removed by its ref, but never the last one
passwords: owner settings, minimum length, right and wrong, and a pause after too many wrong
removing an account ends its sessions and deletes it; only by a person
every change is recorded first; when the record is down nothing changes
a damaged account file refuses sign-in rather than making a second account
a person may name an account; control characters and long names are refused
every email code has plain words; addresses have one form
links open only where an app on the computer may be opened
email links are off until the owner turns them on and sets every value
the email is plain words with one link, its end, and no word on whether an account exists
a link signs in once, makes the account the first time, and finds it after
a link ends on time and is gone once tried; another app's link is refused
the send limit is the owner's; a failed send leaves no link and costs no send
no sender, an assistant, or links turned off: nothing is sent and nothing is kept
the store and the audit log keep no link token; the audit log keeps no address
private email with a password: made once per address, unverified, and signed in by password
a link for an address someone signed up with a password verifies it and clears that password
ended links are swept when the product starts
telemetry is off until the owner turns it on and sets every number; every code has plain words
only probes that meet the contract are run, once each
the disclosure is the probe's own words and every count it can make, also as plain text
nothing is counted before a person says yes; an assistant cannot say yes or no
the meter counts only declared counts, per export interval, and keeps nothing else
saying no deletes what that probe counted for the person, and only that
only ended intervals are exported, added up across people, with small counts suppressed
only a person exports; what is sent is kept in the history and removed from everyone's counts
when the exporter fails nothing is lost; a batch with every series suppressed is dropped, never sent
